The '''Gryphon Caves''' are two caves found on [[The Great Conch]]. Both dungeons contain a number of [[Gryphon]]s, a [[Slayer monster]] requiring 51 [[Slayer]] to kill. A [[Dwarf multicannon]] can be used in both dungeons.

{{Map|width=350|height=280|mtype=pin|zoom=1|y=2465|3120,2489|3235,2417|caption=The entrances to the caves, with the regular area in the north-west and the task-only area in the south-east.|align=left|icon=redPin}}
[[File:Gryphon cave.png|thumb|right|Outside of the Gryphon cave.]]
==South-eastern dungeon==
The dungeon on the eastern side is where Gryphons can only be killed if on a [[Slayer task|slayer task]]. This rule is enforced by [[Elder Kelmo]] who stands just inside the cave entrance. 

The south west part of this dungeon is a [[Multicombat area|multicombat area]]. The other two thirds of the dungeon is [[Single-way combat|single-way combat]].

==North-western dungeon==
No slayer task is needed to kill the Gryphons in the western dungeon. 

This dungeon contains a [[knife]] [[Item spawn|spawn]] which can be used to cut the watermelons dropped by the gryphons to make [[watermelon slice]]s, which can be used to heal and prolong combat.
